from pathlib import Path
import re
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/baba-ali.md')
head, tail = p.read_bytes().split(b'romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
old, body = tail.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)
roman = old.decode()
replacements = {
    'Subhe unis': 'Subh-e-unnis', 'maula': 'Maula', 'shahadat': 'shahaadat',
    'haye': 'haaye', 'Haye': 'Haaye', 'ali': 'Ali', 'hasnain': 'Hasnain',
    'Maahe ramzan': 'Maah-e-Ramzaan', 'maahe aza': 'maah-e-aza',
    'sher e elaahi': 'sher-e-ilaahi', 'may': 'mein', 'hamare': 'hamaare',
    'nahi': 'nahiṅ', 'Jao': 'Jaao', 'aa jaye': 'aa jaaye',
    'zainab': 'Zainab', 'pocha': 'poncha', 'hyder': 'Haidar',
    'Chor ke hum': 'Chhor ke ham', 'Aagayi': 'Aa gayi',
    'ekkeeswi ramzaṅ': 'ikkisviṅ Ramzaaṅ', 'shaam e gharibaṅ': 'shaam-e-gharibaaṅ',
    'hogaye bejaan': 'ho gaye bejaaṅ', 'khamosh': 'khaamosh',
    'kuch': 'kuchh', 'irfan-e-aza': 'Irfaan-e-aza',
    'janaza': 'janaaza', 'dikhao': 'dikhaao',
}
for old_text, new_text in replacements.items():
    roman = re.sub(r'(?<"'!'"\\w)' + re.escape(old_text) + r'(?"'!'"\\w)', new_text, roman)

source = body.decode().strip().splitlines()

p.write_bytes(updated)
assert p.read_bytes() == updated
print(roman)
print(f'{len(lines) - 1} verses. Urdu body and other metadata preserved byte for byte.')
